system.description:
Range 30ft; 1 round per level (concentration).

  • Draw up to 1d4 shadowy creatures from the dark, with total Levels up to your level and each of a Level no higher than half your level.
  • Each uses the stats of a creature you choose, acts on your turn, and deals half damage.
  • Fighting one also calls for the save (see Illusions and disbelief); one that sees through it takes no damage from it.
  • A shadow vanishes at 0 HP.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Bard, Necromancer
system.saveEffect: Sees through it and takes no damage from it
